title: Reversal Candle + Spinning Top Pattern EA
entry_long: reversal candlestick (6 down bars + 3 up bars) OR spinning top (small body with long upper/lower wicks) followed by close(ID0) > open(ID1)
entry_short: mirror: 3 up bars + 6 down bars OR spinning top followed by close(ID0) < open(ID1)
exit: close when total profit >= 100 USD (grouped close)
buildon_idea: Already has 2-lot cap; flat-lot test first; validate cascading entry delay to prevent over-escalation; add position-size limit
novelty_note: Combines reversal + spinning top patterns; simple candlestick analysis; common low-novelty approach

title: Double Hammer Pattern + Martingale Grid
entry_long: double hammer: ID1 lower wick > 2x body size, ID1 body small; ID2 lower wick > upper wick; both body >=4 pips + bullish trend (close > EMA100)
entry_short: bearish mirror: ID1 upper wick long, small body; ID2 upper wick > lower wick
exit: no SL/TP; close when total profit (both sides) >= 100 USD
buildon_idea: Add hard position cap (e.g. max 5 orders); implement linear-add lot law (e.g. +0.1 per level) instead of exponential; add correlation test on live pairs
novelty_note: Double-hammer variant of single hammer; basic candlestick + trend filter; moderate novelty

title: Fair Value Gap (FVG) Scaling - Revision 1
entry_long: Fair Value Gap: low(ID1) > high(ID3); close(ID0) inside gap (between B1 and B2 lines); triggered on range completion 60 pips
entry_short: high(ID1) < low(ID3); close(ID0) inside S-gap
exit: trailing profit 30 USD or on gap breakout; no SL
buildon_idea: Already linear-add; validate MC on 5y holdout; test correlation <0.8 with other gap EAs; add TP/SL per gap size
novelty_note: FVG + grid scaling with linear-add; rare mechanism; medium-high novelty

title: FVG Scalping - Basic Grid Entry
entry_long: FVG: low(ID1) > high(ID3); close(ID0) inside gap range; pending grid orders at 60 pips spacing × 5 levels
entry_short: high(ID1) < low(ID3); close(ID0) inside gap; pending shorts at 60 pips × 5
exit: TP 15 pips per order; SL 20 pips; close at 30 USD total or gap breakout
buildon_idea: Fixed lot is safe; test wider grid (90-120 pips) for reduced correlation; validate SL 20 pips on volatility regimes
novelty_note: Standard FVG pending grid; low novelty

title: MACD Divergence + Grid with Groups
entry_long: MACD bullish divergence (low < low of ref candle, MACD > MACD of ref) + grid 10 pips spacing
entry_short: MACD bearish divergence (high > high, MACD < MACD)
exit: close when total profit (both groups) >= 10 USD
buildon_idea: Capped at 2.0; implement classic vs hidden divergence selector (groups 1+2); validate Model-2 on 3y window; add SL at 1.5× ATR
novelty_note: MACD divergence + dual-group grid; moderate novelty

title: Stochastic Within Limit + Auto Lot Sizing
entry_long: Stochastic(%K, %D) in oversold (1-30) range + bullish candle (open < close, body >= 5 pips)
entry_short: Stochastic in overbought (70-100) range + bearish candle (open > close, body >= 5 pips)
exit: close when profit >= 30 pips; lot scales with balance (Balance / 100000)
buildon_idea: Auto-lot is good; add SL at 2×ATR or 50-pips fixed; validate balance scaling ratio on MC; test fixed vs proportional modes
novelty_note: Auto lot-sizing based on balance is useful; simple stochastic entry; medium novelty

title: ADX Trend + Pending Grid Orders
entry_long: ADX crosses above 30 (strong trend) + place 5 pending buy orders 30 pips below current price in grid
entry_short: ADX > 30 + place 5 pending sell orders 30 pips above
exit: close when profit (both sides) >= 100 USD; delete pending if no fill after 5 candles
buildon_idea: Fixed lots; pending orders safe; validate ADX threshold (20 vs 30 vs 40) per symbol; add time-decay filter (delete after N bars)
novelty_note: ADX trigger for pending grid; mechanical entry; low-medium novelty

title: ICT Price Action - Engulfing Candles
entry_long: Bearish candle ID1 (open > close, body >=30 pips) + bullish engulfing ID0 (body of ID1 > 50% of ID0); SL at close(ID1), TP 200% of SL
entry_short: Bullish ID1 + bearish engulfing ID0; SL at open(ID1), TP 200% of SL
exit: TP at 200% distance; SL at entry level; delete pending if no fill after 5 candles
buildon_idea: Capped martingale; SL in place; validate candle filters on MC; test stricter body-size thresholds (40+ pips)
novelty_note: ICT engulfing pattern + TP scaling; medium novelty

title: ICT Price Action V2 - Distance-Based Entry
entry_long: Bearish candles ID1 + ID4 (body >= 5 pips) + distance(close(ID1)-open(ID4)) > 60 pips; draw horizontal line at open(ID1)
entry_short: Bullish candles ID1 + ID4 + distance(close(ID1)-open(ID4)) > 60 pips
exit: TP 30 pips; SL 20 pips; on fill, delete opposite-side line
buildon_idea: Good distance & SL; validate min distance (40-60 pips) per TF; add MC with correlation filter; test unequal SL/TP ratios
novelty_note: ICT + explicit distance grid; medium-high novelty

title: GRD Trading System - First/Last Close Order (Original)
entry_long: RSI < 30 (oversold) + bullish doji (bottom wick > 2× body, top wick short); grid 100 pips spacing × 5 levels
entry_short: RSI > 70 (overbought) + bearish doji
exit: close first + last pair together when total profit >= 5 USD; 30 USD per trade
escalation_cap: 2.0 per level (capped max 9 orders, ~2.56 highest lot)
buildon_idea: Capped grid (9 orders); first/last close is elegant; validate SL at 1.5×ATR; test correlation on multi-symbol; add trailing stop
novelty_note: GRD unique close strategy (first+last only); medium novelty

title: GRD Trading System - Revision 1 (Multi-Pair)
entry_long: RSI < 30 + bullish doji (candle ID1 close > open, bottom wick > 2× body) + grid 100 pips; max 30 orders
entry_short: RSI > 70 + bearish doji
exit: first/last close pair; total profit >=5 USD; cut loss if DD > 30%
buildon_idea: Capped by order limit (30); add SL at break-even or 2×ATR; validate on >=2 symbols (XAU+SPY); MC with position correlation filter
novelty_note: GRD refined; extended testing on gold; medium novelty

title: ICT Engulfing Pattern - Revision 1 (Line Draw + Zone)
entry_long: Bearish candles ID1-3 + bullish engulfing ID0 (close(ID0) > open(ID1)); draw entry line at open(ID1); pending buy orders within zone
entry_short: Bullish candles ID1-3 + bearish engulfing
exit: TP on zone breakout; SL at opposite zone boundary; line deletion on gap breakout
buildon_idea: Linear-add is safer; zones are explicit; validate zone width (50-100 pips) per asset; test wider zones on low-vol pairs
novelty_note: ICT zones + line drawing; explicit zone mechanics; medium-high novelty

title: GD Trading System - EMA Concept (Original)
entry_long: EMA10 > EMA200 (uptrend) + blue candle ID1 (open < close, body >= 5 pips) + close crosses above EMA10
entry_short: EMA10 < EMA200 (downtrend) + red candle ID1 + close crosses below EMA10
exit: close when profit >= 30 USD; SL/TP fixed (20/30 pips); grid 20 pips spacing
buildon_idea: Good EMA trend filter; SL in place; validate EMA periods (5/50 vs 10/200) on multiple TF; test correlation <0.6 across pairs
novelty_note: EMA + candlestick entry; common but solid; medium novelty

title: GD Trading System - EMA RV1 (Extended Backtest)
entry_long: EMA10 > EMA200 + blue candle (body >= 5) + close crosses above EMA10; grid 20 pips × 30 max orders
entry_short: EMA10 < EMA200 + red candle + cross below EMA10
exit: close profit >=30 USD; SL/TP 20/30 pips; DD < 27% on 5y backtest
escalation_cap: 2.0; total profit all 6 test variants >250% on 5y
buildon_idea: Proven on 5y; scalable; add SL at 2×ATR dynamic; test wider grid (30-40 pips) on volatile pairs; validate lot-scaling scenarios
novelty_note: GD production variant; robust on extended backtest; medium novelty

title: Martingale Strategy + Trailing Stop + 9-Level Grid
entry_long: EMA3 > EMA8 > EMA200 (uptrend align) + grid 100 pips; 9 orders max; lot X = 2.0 (doubles each level)
entry_short: EMA3 < EMA8 < EMA200 (downtrend align)
exit: trailing stop: start 200 pips, step 10 pips; close money (profit target) = 5 USD per single; escalate per levels
escalation_cap: 2.0 per level; hard cap 3.0 total lot (2.56 max from 9 levels)
buildon_idea: Capped grid (9 orders); trailing stop built-in; validate SL + TS interaction (avoid chop); test level 6/7/8 on different symbols
novelty_note: Martingale + trailing stop combo; practical design; medium-high novelty
